blocks.text: Jab macrophages hamla karne wale microbes par hamla karte hain to pyrogens naam ke chemicals chhorte hain. Pyrogens khoon ke zariye dimagh tak ja kar hypothalamus tak pohanchte hain. Hypothalamus jism ka thermostat (hararat qaboo karne wala hissa) hai. Yahan pyrogens hypothalamus ko uksate hain ke jism ki andaruni (core) hararat normal 37 °C (98.6 °F) se oopar le jaye. Is se jism ka temperature barh jata hai. Normal se zyada temperature ko fever (bukhar) ya pyrexia kehte hain. Bukhar microbes ke khilaf difa ka aik tareeqa hai. Yeh bacteria aur viruses ki apni tadaad barhane (reproduce karne) ki salahiyat ko rokta hai. Kuch microbes (maslan Streptococcus pneumoniae aur Influenza virus) garmi se hassas (temperature-sensitive) hain aur tez bukhar mein mar jate hain. Bukhar neutrophils aur macrophages ke kaam ki raftaar bhi barha deta hai. Bukhar ke dauran jism zyada cytokines (interferons) chhorta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “Streptococcus pneumonia” likhti hai. Is bacterium ka sahi scientific naam Streptococcus pneumoniae hai (aakhir mein -ae).

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbon ka silsila: macrophages hamla awar jaraseem par hamla karte; pyrogens chhorte jo khoon ke raaste dimagh tak jate; pyrogens hypothalamus (jism ka thermostat) ko uksate; jism ki andaruni hararat 37 C (98.6 F) se oopar: bukhar (pyrexia).
blocks.caption: Bukhar kaise shuru hota hai (topic 21.2.4 ke liye hamara asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi figure nahi).

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Aam taur par 103 °F (39.4 °C) se zyada temperature khatarnak samjha jata hai, aur 105 °F (40.5 °C) se zyada aksar jaan lewa hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Macrophage se bukhar tak ka raasta qadam ba qadam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Macrophages microbes par hamla karte waqt pyrogens chhorte hain; pyrogens khoon ke zariye dimagh ke hypothalamus tak pohanchte hain; hypothalamus jism ki core hararat 37 °C se oopar kar deta hai: yeh fever hai.

items: Macrophages ke pyrogens hypothalamus (jism ka thermostat) ko core temperature 37 °C (98.6 °F) se oopar karne par uksate hain: fever (pyrexia).
Bukhar microbes ki reproduction rokta, kuch microbes ko maarta, neutrophils aur macrophages ko tez karta aur cytokines barhata hai.
103 °F (39.4 °C) se oopar khatarnak, 105 °F (40.5 °C) se oopar aksar jaan lewa.
